def _parse_html_to_newline(state: BlockState, newline: Pattern[str]) ->int:
    start_pos = state.cursor
    while state.cursor < state.cursor_max:
        # Find the next newline
        m = newline.search(state.src, state.cursor)
        if not m:
            # No more newlines, consume rest of text
            state.cursor = state.cursor_max
            break
            
        # Check if we're at the end of a line that's part of the HTML block
        end_of_line = m.end()
        
        # Look ahead to see if there's more content that should be included
        # or if this is the end of the HTML block
        pos = end_of_line
        while pos < state.cursor_max and state.src[pos] in ' \t':
            pos += 1
            
        # If we hit a blank line or end of document, we're done
        if pos >= state.cursor_max or state.src[pos] == '\n':
            state.cursor = end_of_line
            break
            
        # Otherwise, continue parsing
        state.cursor = end_of_line
        
    # Add the HTML content as a token
    text = state.get_text(state.cursor)
    state.append_token({'type': 'block_html', 'raw': text})
    return state.cursor
